chunks: Whatever is in it from ʿUbayd Allah al-Rāfiqī, I have narrated it from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad ibn Masrūr—may Allah be pleased with him—from al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĀmir, from his uncle ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿĀmir, from Abū Aḥmad Muḥammad ibn Ziyād al-Azdī, from ʿUbayd Allah al-Rāfiqī.

key_terms.الْأَزْدِيِّ: al-Azdī; the tribal attribution of Muḥammad ibn Ziyād
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: may Allah be pleased with him; an honorific supplication
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s act of narration
key_terms.عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّافِقِيِّ: ʿUbayd Allah al-Rāfiqī, the source narrator named in this chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿUbayd Allah al-Rāfiqī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage provides the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿUbayd Allah al-Rāfiqī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission and preserving the scholarly route by which these hadith reached the compiler.
